## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `mypy`
- [ ] `pytest -q`

## Safety and evidence

- [ ] Collectors remain read-only; every proposed action goes through policy.
- [ ] New factual AI claims cite stable evidence IDs, if applicable.
- [ ] Docs and `HACKATHON.md` reflect behavior changes, if applicable.
